title: An extension of a critical Hardy--Rellich inequality: explicit constants and the sharp weight range
summary: We revisit the critical Hardy--Rellich inequalities recently established by Castro in "A critical Hardy--Rellich inequality (preprint, arXiv:2511.16537, 2025)". Using the classical one-dimensional weighted Hardy inequality in Emden--Fowler variables, we prove that the weighted inequality holds exactly for $a\neq N$, with $a=N$ as the unique critical value. We derive explicit constants for $N\ge2$, obtain the sharp constant in dimension one, and extend the $Δu$ formulation to the Muckenhoupt range $-N<a<N(N-1)$, $a\neq N$.
